latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of "AI Subtitle Japanese to English" skill.
- Translate Japanese speech in video files (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB) into English subtitles, automatically burned into the video.
- Simple workflow: upload video, give instructions (e.g., "translate Japanese speech to English subtitles"), download 1080p MP4.
- Handles common tasks: export, show credits, view status, upload files, and edit tracks via keyword/intent recognition.
- All cloud processing is automatic—no manual transcription or video editing needed.
- Includes error handling for common issues (token expiry, file size/format, rate limits) and clear user prompts.
